video: A input, B output, existing 720p qualification/raw four-lane AV pipeline. Default local even with qualified HDMI. UART START requires ready input; STOP, input loss, or 3-second keepalive expiry revoke authorization. Reconnect does not auto-authorize. Background local media/network never reset by the command path.

uart.crc: CRC-8/SMBUS poly07 init00 no reflection xorout00, first four bytes

player.runtime: Windows10/11 x64, .NET Framework4.8 and system media components; no Python, Ethernet control or third-party player

simulation_limits: Integrated test uses real vendor PHY/PLL/CSB/encoder models with scaled geometry and background media/network stub. Island-style payload checks are not valid LPCM/BCH generation. Real USB-UART, input sampling eye, monitor relock, and PC HDMI audio route still require board verification. Existing vendor startup warnings disclosed.
drc: No multi-drive or abnormal timing paths; original PHY7002 SDRAM initial-location and PHY5079 local SDRAM clock route warnings remain. No new clock/timing exceptions or PLL changes.
